```{r}
library(DBI)

library(gt)
library(plotly)

con <- conn
```

## Executive Summary

```{r}
# KPI Query
kpi_query <- "
SELECT 
  SUM(NET_REVENUE) as TOTAL_REVENUE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_KEY) as ACTIVE_CUSTOMERS,
  AVG(CURRENT_BALANCE) as AVG_BALANCE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DORMANT = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as DORMANCY_RATE
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_CUSTOMER_REVENUE cr
LEFT JOIN FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_DAILY ab 
  ON cr.CUSTOMER_KEY = ab.CUSTOMER_KEY
WHERE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()) = MONTH(cr.MONTH_KEY)
"

kpis <- dbGetQuery(con, kpi_query)
```

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-3}

## Revenue by Product

```{r}
revenue_by_product <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  p.PRODUCT_NAME,
  SUM(cr.NET_REVENUE) as REVENUE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cr.CUSTOMER_KEY) as CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_CUSTOMER_REVENUE cr
LEFT JOIN FSI_DEMO.CORE_BANKING.DIM_PRODUCT p ON cr.PRODUCT_KEY = p.PRODUCT_KEY
GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_NAME
ORDER BY REVENUE DESC
")

ggplot(revenue_by_product, aes(x = reorder(PRODUCT_NAME, REVENUE), y = REVENUE)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1f77b4") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Revenue by Product", x = "", y = "Revenue ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Top 10 Branches by Revenue

```{r}
top_branches <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  b.BRANCH_NAME,
  b.REGION,
  SUM(cr.NET_REVENUE) as REVENUE
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_CUSTOMER_REVENUE cr
LEFT JOIN FSI_DEMO.CORE_BANKING.DIM_BRANCH b ON cr.BRANCH_KEY = b.BRANCH_KEY
GROUP BY b.BRANCH_NAME, b.REGION
ORDER BY REVENUE DESC
LIMIT 10
")

gt(top_branches) |>
  fmt_currency(columns = REVENUE, currency = "USD")
```

## Churn Risk Distribution

```{r}
churn_dist <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  CHURN_RISK_SEGMENT,
  COUNT(*) as CUSTOMER_COUNT
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.ML_CHURN_SCORES
GROUP BY CHURN_RISK_SEGMENT
")

ggplot(churn_dist, aes(x = CHURN_RISK_SEGMENT, y = CUSTOMER_COUNT, fill = CHURN_RISK_SEGMENT)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Customers by Churn Risk", x = "Risk Segment", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Monthly Trends

```{r}
monthly_trends <- dbGetQuery(con, "
SELECT 
  MONTH_KEY,
  SUM(NET_REVENUE) as REVENUE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_KEY) as CUSTOMERS
FROM FSI_DEMO.ANALYTICS_BANKING.FACT_CUSTOMER_REVENUE
GROUP BY MONTH_KEY
ORDER BY MONTH_KEY DESC
LIMIT 12
")

ggplot(monthly_trends, aes(x = MONTH_KEY, y = REVENUE)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Revenue Trend (Last 12 Months)", x = "Month", y = "Revenue ($)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
